mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to reduction in income taxes as a result of deductions of allowable expenditures from the income of individuals or companies."
Tax shield simply refers to reduction in income taxes as a result of deductions of allowable expenditures from the income of individuals or companies.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an allowance granted to an entity or taxpayer for incurring and using qualifying capital expenditure during a year of assessment for the purpose of deriving its income."
Capital allowance is an allowance granted to an entity or taxpayer for incurring and using qualifying capital expenditure during a year of assessment for the purpose of deriving its income.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the addition of the earned and unearned income."
Statutory income here simply refers to the addition of the earned and unearned income.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an employee of OTEGBIKU UNIVERSITY."
Chief Otapiapia is an employee of OTEGBIKU UNIVERSITY.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the period for which the taxpayer's income is being assessed to tax."
Basis period is the period for which the taxpayer's income is being assessed to tax.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are made up to 31 August every year."
Accounts are made up to 31 August every year.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a construction company incorporated in Nigeria with affiliates worldwide."
Julius Berger is a construction company incorporated in Nigeria with affiliates worldwide.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that can be found in the governmental sector."
Public companies are those that can be found in the governmental sector.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an allowance granted to a taxpayer who is incapacitated with special equipment and services of an attendant in the course of his paid occupation."
Disabled person allowance is an allowance granted to a taxpayer who is incapacitated with special equipment and services of an attendant in the course of his paid occupation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the period for which the taxpayer or company has declared a profit or loss in its financial statements."
Accounting year end refers to the period for which the taxpayer or company has declared a profit or loss in its financial statements.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sole proprietor of JCB Enterprise, which is a major distributor to leading manufacturing companies in Nigeria for a long time now."
Ahmad Ibrahim is the sole proprietor of JCB Enterprise, which is a major distributor to leading manufacturing companies in Nigeria for a long time now.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a government levy (tax) imposed on a trade or profession, individuals or entities (taxpayers)."
An income tax is a government levy (tax) imposed on a trade or profession, individuals or entities (taxpayers).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the second stage in income tax administration."
The assessment of income is the second stage in income tax administration.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to income from sources other than those gotten from employment, business or reward for services rendered."
Unearned income refers to income from sources other than those gotten from employment, business or reward for services rendered.
fib: ______ is one of the types of capital allowances which may be claimed once and in the year when the qualifying capital expenditure is first put to use.
Initial allowance
Initial allowance is one of the types of capital allowances which may be claimed once and in the year when the qualifying capital expenditure is first put to use.
______ is a trade in its extended sense remains a mixed question of law and fact.
Whether or not an activity
Whether or not an activity is a trade in its extended sense remains a mixed question of law and fact.
______ are the basic principles of taxation that guide tax administration as well as the implementation of the provisions of relevant tax laws.
Canons of taxation
The Canons of taxation are the basic principles of taxation that guide tax administration as well as the implementation of the provisions of relevant tax laws.
______ refers to any trade, profession or vocation but excludes employment.
business
A business refers to any trade, profession or vocation but excludes employment.

Earned income simply
Earned income simply refers to all such incomes emanating from a trade, business, profession, vocation or employment, carried on or exercised by an individual.
______ is a deliberate and willful practice of not disclosing full taxable income so as to pay less tax.
Tax evasion
Tax evasion is a deliberate and willful practice of not disclosing full taxable income so as to pay less tax.

Balancing charge or adjustments is one of the elements of balancing adjustment, which is gotten when an asset is disposed of.

Preceding year basis
Preceding year basis is the basis in which the income of a taxpayer or entity in the immediate prior accounting year is being assessed to tax in the present accounting year or year of assessment.
______ refers to normal regular routine commercial activity, because it connotes the idea of continuity.
Trade
Trade refers to normal regular routine commercial activity, because it connotes the idea of continuity.

Qualifying capital expenditure means capital expenditure incurred in a basis period.

Ultimate year (final year)
Ultimate year
Ultimate year (final year) is the first day of the year to the last day of the same year in which the organization completely ceased to engage in business.

Earned income specifically
Earned income specifically refers to all incomes that emanates from a trade, business, profession, vocation or employment, carried on or exercised by an individual.
______ is the year immediately before the year in which a business ceases to exist.
Penultimate year as mentioned earlier
Penultimate year as mentioned earlier is the year immediately before the year in which a business ceases to exist.
